scope: These are the local supervised/fine-tuning inputs and their source specifications/RTL. Evaluation outputs, GRPO logs, candidate batches, paper text, and the external slice package are intentionally excluded because they are not training inputs. Public pretraining contamination cannot be measured from this workspace and must be disclosed separately.
unresolved_limitation: The provenance of the base model's public pretraining corpus is unavailable; exact public-pretraining exposure to RTLLM cannot be excluded.
